QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Lohd? Dark Lord?
QuestInfo.0: You found Lohd at #m300020200# and asked him about the situation there. What could be the best site for their town?
QuestInfo.1: You must eliminate 100 Mossy Mushrooms and prove your strength to Lohd.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated a mess of Mossy Mushrooms as Lohd requested. Is Lohd thinking the same thing as Athena Pierce? And could this person have something to do with Dark Lord, shadowy master of Kerning City?

0.0: I guess Athena Pierce was curious about this place. It's just as I expected...lots of low hills, and not so many trees. It would surely be easier to build a town here.
0.1: So, Kao. Are you still training? You hardly look any stronger than when I last saw you. I think you need a challenge.
0.2: Don't take it personally. Just prove your strength. You can take out the monsters in this area, right?

yes.0: How about you take out #b#e100 Mossy Mushrooms#k#n?

no.0: Eh? Where's your confidence? Where's your pride? Don't disappoint me, Kao.

1.0: Have you finished with the Mossy Mushrooms?

yes.0: Not bad! But remember, you must be confident in yourself. Depend on your own strength. I respect Athena Pierce for what she's done, but we disagree on many things. You cannot follow someone blindly...you must remain true to your own convictions. I will go tell Athena Pierce myself, so you do what you must.

default.0: Still not done? I worry about your future, Kao!
